# feckless-graphics-handler-for-tab5
#
# The two fonts were components of their own in the player
# (components/ark12, components/arabixel). A git dependency is one
# component, so here they are compiled into this one from fonts/, with
# their own READMEs and licences beside them: Ark Pixel is OFL-1.1 and
# LICENSE-OFL must ship with any redistribution of the firmware;
# Arabixel Basic's table is CC BY 4.0. Both tables are generated by
# tools/ and committed -- see those scripts for why.
#
# esp_lcd is PUBLIC because gfx.h and lcd.h hand out its panel handle.
#
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "src/lcd.c" "src/gfx.c"
         "fonts/ark12/ark12.c"
         "fonts/arabixel/arabixel_tab.c" "fonts/arabixel/arabixel_shape.c"
    INCLUDE_DIRS "include" "fonts/ark12" "fonts/arabixel"
    REQUIRES esp_lcd
    PRIV_REQUIRES esp_driver_ledc esp_driver_gpio esp_hw_support hal
             esp_lcd_st7121
)
